profile.startupReferenceNote: Robot-left = R-11; robot-right = L-10. Only J2/J4 fitted, J1/J3/J5/J6/J7 held at zero as requested. These are vendor-single-B1 model q values, not raw hardware positions or measured boot offsets. Fresh vision establishes the actual hanging pose tomorrow. First physical direction test: R-11 J2 positive, then L-10 J2 negative, one arm at a time. Command units and hardware/model signs must be confirmed first. Visual non-confirmation is a fault, never a successful move. September 18 visual corrections are in review-adjustments.json. Part angle controls adjust pose independently of fixed URDF origins. B1 housing/chain frame indexing is operator-estimated; left J2/J4 model q now uses the opposite sign from the first single-arm surface-fit candidate. Hardware-positive CCW and R-11/L-10 identities are unchanged. Operator confirms J1 metal limiters are absent on both B1 arms and suspects no limiters on any arm joint. Treat all 14 joints as having no dependable mechanical stop. Overrotation can pull out arm cables and cause damage. Vendor mesh tabs and numeric model ranges are not physical protection or validated cable-safe limits. Keep all B1 joints bounded/revolute; do not enable continuous rotation or endpoint seeking. Physical motion requires independently verified cable-safe bounds and fresh pose confirmation. September 19 operator visual correction: move both complete B1 arm assemblies backward 0.5 inch (12.7 mm) along ROB-base -X at the adjusted hanging reference. Apply at the fixed torso mounts; preserve height, 111 mm mounting span, outward cant, housing clocking and all joint pose angles. Operator-requested estimate, not an automatic surface-fit result.
